payload.reason: The evidence provides specific mentions of baseline methods used in sentiment classification, including NaiveNN and FANN, and discusses their limitations compared to the proposed method DAS.

claims.text: Baseline methods include NaiveNN and FANN, which train sentiment classifiers solely on the source domain.
Baseline methods are unable to produce discriminative features on the target domain due to their training approach.
DAS improves upon baseline methods by refining the classifier on the target domain with semi-supervised learning.
